name: impact-learner-interview-guide
description: Prepares the guide for short voluntary interviews with learners after a programme, producing a consent script, five questions in a fixed order with probes for evidence, a notes template keyed by case letter with no names, and an access rule for raw notes. Use for "run impact-learner-interview-guide", "learner interview guide", "interview questions after training", "success case interviews", "how to interview training participants", "consent script for learner interviews", "more than it was useful", part of the Claude Guide for Training Impact Pack by 90n.
